summary: Completed final testing of Caller ID Permission Management module. Fixed unit test mocks for clearInvalidDefaults() audit logging. Rewrote integration tests with proper independent fixtures and cleanup. Added DTO validation tests and resolveSignaledIdentity tests. All 77 unit tests pass. 24 integration tests properly gated for TEST_DATABASE_URL. UI tested on desktop/mobile, light/dark modes - correctly shows disconnected state with no fabricated data.

backend_issues.notes: All backend tests passing. No issues found.

frontend_issues.notes: UI correctly displays 'Database-backed workspace not connected' state. No DEMO banner present. Controls appropriately disabled. Register dialog works. Tabs functional. Dark/light modes work. Mobile responsive.

passed_tests: Unit Tests (77 passed):
- E.164 normalization and validation (7 tests)
- Injection prevention (newlines, excessive length)
- Default deny policy enforcement
- Authorization requirements (account eligible, number authorized, not expired)
- Per-call selection disabled by default
- External caller ID restrictions (passthrough, status, evidence, additional review)
- Assigned vs external number handling
- Carrier policy enforcement (validated, health, external capability)
- Carrier deny overrides customer permission
- Routing always returns false (outbound unavailable)
- RBAC enforcement (SUPER_ADMIN and COMPLIANCE_ADMIN only for edits)
- Admin read access for all organizations
- Customer read access for own organization only
- Tenant isolation (404 for wrong organization IDs)
- Optimistic locking (409 on version conflicts for settings, requests, and numbers)
- Duplicate pending request prevention (409)
- Request decision once (409 on already-decided requests)
- No automatic ownership on approval (audit log verification)
- Evidence and ownership confirmation required for authorization
- Additional review required when policy demands it
- Revoke/withdraw clears invalid trunk defaults with per-trunk audit logs
- Audit logging in same transaction
- Default setting validates authorized inventory
- Carrier flags loaded server-side (forged flags rejected)
- DTO validation (passthrough requires APPROVED status)
- Settings update blocked when pending request exists
- Number submission duplicate prevention
- Authorization expiry validation (must be future date)
- DTO validation with class-validator (10 tests): forbidden fields, invalid UUID, invalid version, reason length, ISO8601 dates
- resolveSignaledIdentity tests (8 tests): matching identities, normalization, conflicting From/PAI rejection, injection prevention
Integration Tests (24 properly gated for TEST_DATABASE_URL):
- Request enable workflow (3 tests)
- Request decision workflow (3 tests)
- Number authorization workflow (5 tests)
- Trunk default management (3 tests)
- Settings management (3 tests)
- RBAC enforcement (3 tests)
- Tenant isolation (1 test)
- Workspace data integrity (1 test)
- Database constraints (2 tests)
UI Tests:

- Desktop light mode: ✓ Loads correctly, shows 'Database-backed workspace not connected', 'Pending Upstream Activation' label, tabs (Permissions, Authorized inventory, My requests, SIP trunk defaults, Audit history), Register Caller ID dialog with proper fields and 'Submission requires authenticated account' message
- Desktop dark mode: ✓ Theme toggle works, proper dark styling, 'No inventory loaded' empty state
- Mobile view: ✓ Responsive layout, all elements accessible

- Admin view: ✓ Shows 'Caller ID permissions' admin interface, 'Customer database unavailable', disabled controls, proper RBAC messaging ('Only Super Admin and Compliance Admin can modify permissions')
- No DEMO banner present (correct)
- Controls appropriately disabled for absent DB
- Register dialog opens and closes properly
- No fabricated customer data displayed
